name: DraftKV
title: Attention-Guided KV Retrieval for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Retrieves local and salient long-range memories from full-precision CPU-resident KV, using low-resolution attention scores to balance long-term memory and inference cost.
results: 35.4% lower peak GPU memory on SolarWM-H3 33B, with improved generation quality and long-history consistency.
1.21× end-to-end speedup for 60-second LongLive 1.0 generation; 1.91× / 2.51× Fetch+Attention speedups on RTX 4090 / 5090.
methods: Extended DraftAttention2’s low-resolution importance scoring to historical KV retrieval.
Designed Streaming FlashAttention to overlap host-to-device KV transfer with attention computation.

name: DraftAttention2
title: Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention for Video Generation
summary: Uses low-resolution attention importance estimates to route visual interactions to 16-bit, 8/4-bit, or sparse computation, preserving critical information in few-step diffusion.
results: Up to 2.51× / 2.60× DiT inference speedups on HunyuanVideo-13B / MiniMax-H3.
1.87× speedup in 8-step video generation while maintaining near-dense attention quality.
methods: Combined average/max dual-path pooling with an attention-output error bound to study mixed precision versus pure sparsity.
Designed a fused CUDA kernel for quantization, data reordering, and cross-precision Online Softmax, reducing intermediate writes and redundant memory traffic.

name: MosaicAttention
title: Sparse Attention for Multi-View Geometry Transformers
summary: Combines 2D average/max pooling and hierarchical sparse routing to retain important cross-view geometry while reducing redundant global attention.
results: Up to 3.12× end-to-end inference speedup at 128 input views, while matching or improving accuracy on CO3Dv2 and other multi-view geometry tasks.
methods: Allocated computation across layers while preserving 2D image structure and critical cross-view interactions.
Incorporated mixed-precision execution to further improve inference efficiency.

name: Mind Dreamer
title: Untethering World-Model Imagination via Active Intervention
summary: Addresses Historical Tethering in model-based reinforcement learning by synthesizing high-value latent states as new imagination starting points beyond observed trajectories.
results: 1.67× average and up to 8.8× sample-efficiency gains over DreamerV3 on DeepMind Control Suite, with higher final returns on multiple sparse-reward tasks.
methods: Identified how imagination initialized only from observed states limits exploration of unvisited, high-value regions.
Jointly scored task value and uncertainty to guide active exploration in latent space.

name: Beyond Token Supervision
title: Semantic Anchors for Latent Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Uses sparse autoencoders to extract semantic features from an explicit chain-of-thought teacher and supervise intermediate latent reasoning states.
results: 11.7% GSM8K accuracy improvement over the COCONUT latent-reasoning baseline, reducing semantic drift.
methods: Identified semantic drift caused by the absence of explicit intermediate supervision in continuous latent reasoning.
Aligned intermediate latent states with semantic anchors extracted from correct explicit reasoning trajectories.
